First, secure a room for 2 adults and 1 child at the Sheraton Hotel in New York with check-in on May 1, 2022, and check-out on May 5, 2022. Then, reserve a room for 1 adult and 2 children at the Marriott in Los Angeles, checking in on June 1, 2022, and checking out on June 10, 2022.
